name: body
material: ASA black, one piece (v5: chassis + nose merged), floor on the bed

name: clamp_L
material: ASA black, split face on the bed

name: clamp_R
material: ASA black, split face on the bed

name: insert_M3x6_strap
material: HEAT-SET INSERT M3x6: body, top of the 8 motor-saddle ears (press in with the soldering iron before the motor goes in)

name: screw_M3x10_strap
material: BOLT M3x10 socket head: through the motor strap clamp into the ear insert

name: insert_M3x6_pcb
material: HEAT-SET INSERT M3x6: body, top of the 4 PCB standoffs

name: motor_L
material: DC motor 24x18.3 can (STL in CAD/ref)

name: motor_R
material: DC motor 24x18.3 can (STL in CAD/ref)

name: rim_rear_L
material: PLA (ASA later), 0.2 nozzle (m0.5 teeth)

name: tyre_rear_L
material: TPU 90A

name: rim_rear_R
material: PLA (ASA later), 0.2 nozzle (m0.5 teeth)

name: tyre_rear_R
material: TPU 90A

name: bearing_MR105_rear
material: MR105-2RS 5x10x4

name: axle_bolt_M5x40
material: BOLT M5x40 socket head: rear axle, from the wheel side (M5x30 is too short for the nylock)

name: nut_M5_rear
material: PLAIN NUT M5 (no insert): dropped into the slot in the axle tower from the top, tighten fully (clamps the inner races, the bolt does not turn)

name: shim_rear
material: Shim washer 5x7x0.5 stainless (inner race only)

name: pinion
material: 10T m0.5 brass on the motor (have)

name: rim_front_L
material: PLA (ASA later)

name: tyre_front_L
material: TPU 90A

name: rim_front_R
material: PLA (ASA later)

name: tyre_front_R
material: TPU 90A

name: bearing_MR105_front
material: MR105-2RS 5x10x4

name: knuckle_L
material: ASA black, stands on its flat feet (inner side down), spacer up

name: knuckle_R
material: ASA black, stands on its flat feet (inner side down), spacer up

name: axle_bolt_M5x20
material: BOLT M5x20 socket head: front axle from the wheel side, threadlocker

name: nut_M5_front
material: PLAIN NUT M5 (no insert): in the hex pocket on the inside of the knuckle, before the knuckle goes on

name: shim_front
material: Shim washer 5x7x0.5 stainless (inner race only)

name: servo
material: SpringRC SM-S2309S (have), upright, body through the floor, tabs held down by the 2 printed clamp bars

name: servo_clamp
material: ASA black, 2 flat bars 4.5 mm over the servo tabs (one STL holds both)

name: insert_M3x6_servo
material: HEAT-SET INSERT M3x6: body, top of the 2 servo towers (4x), before the servo goes in

name: screw_M3x10_servo
material: BOLT M3x10 socket head: through the servo clamp bars into the tower inserts

name: servo_horn
material: ASA black, printed horn 4 mm: press onto the 4.76 spline (bore 4.78) (drop of CA if loose); the tie rods on the pin keep it down; top face on the bed

name: tie_rod_L
material: ASA black, 3.5 x 7 flat, top on the bed; pivots on M4 + 2 jammed nuts, must turn freely

name: tie_rod_R
material: ASA black, 3.5 x 7 flat, top on the bed; pivots on M4 + 2 jammed nuts, must turn freely

name: screw_M4_steering
material: BOLT M4x20 (horn pin) + M4x25 (left arm) + M4x30 (right arm): from below, head under the horn / arm boss

name: nut_M4_steering
material: 2 PLAIN NUTS M4 per pivot, on top of the tie rods: jam them (first snug, back off 1/8, lock the second); the rods must turn freely

name: kingpin_M4x30
material: BOLT M4x30 socket head: kingpin, head down through both knuckle lugs and the beam

name: nut_M4_kingpin
material: 2 PLAIN NUTS M4 per kingpin, on top: first one until the play is gone, back off 1/8 turn, hold it and lock the second against it

name: buck_LM2596
material: LM2596 module 43x21 on the PCB (J6/J7): trimpot to 5.0 V first, then 2x M3x10 + nut, pads soldered with wire stubs

name: spacer_buck
material: ASA black spacer Ø6 x 3, M3 hole: between LM2596 and PCB (plastic, a metal nut would touch IN+)

name: screw_M3x10_buck
material: BOLT M3x10 socket head: LM2596 hole -> printed spacer -> PCB

name: nut_M3_buck
material: NUT M3 (ISO 4032) under the PCB, 2.5 mm above the battery

name: battery_2S
material: ERYNK 7.4 V 1500 mAh 2S pack (80x41x18.72 measured), JST BEC, in a 3 mm floor pocket + elastic band

name: pcb_envelope
material: PCB 100x70 + 2 mm leads (collision check only)

name: devkit_ESP32
material: ESP32 DevKit v1 30-pin (Heemol, have)

name: screw_M3x6_pcb
material: BOLT M3x6 socket head: through the PCB corner hole into the standoff insert (max M3x10)
